WITH r AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_record(convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb)
  AS x(task_id text, schema_version text, context_id text, title text, success_criterion text, actor text, status text, priority text, due_at timestamptz, idempotency_key text, body jsonb)
), vorher AS (
  SELECT t.task_id FROM jarvis_privat.task t JOIN r ON t.idempotency_key = r.idempotency_key
), neu AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.task (task_id, schema_version, context_id, title, success_criterion, actor, status, priority, due_at, idempotency_key, body)
  SELECT task_id, schema_version, context_id, title, success_criterion, actor, status, priority, due_at, idempotency_key, body FROM r
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vorher)
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING task_id
)
SELECT coalesce((SELECT task_id FROM neu), (SELECT task_id FROM vorher)) AS resolved_id,
       CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM neu) THEN 'created'
            WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vorher) THEN 'existing'
            ELSE 'conflict' END AS write_outcome

SELECT (t.task_id IS NOT NULL) AS found, $2::text AS write_outcome, t.task_id, t.context_id, t.title, t.success_criterion, t.actor, t.status, t.priority,
       to_char(t.due_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS due_at, t.idempotency_key::text AS idempotency_key
FROM (SELECT 1) AS eins LEFT JOIN jarvis_privat.task t ON t.task_id = $1
